name: henwood-app-analytics
description: Builds /analytics.js for henwood.app. The site itself has no build step; this is only for refreshing that one file.

scripts.build: esbuild analytics.src.js --bundle --format=esm --minify --target=es2020 --outfile=../../analytics.js --banner:js="/* Built from tools/analytics/analytics.src.js. Don't edit by hand: cd tools/analytics && npm ci && npm run build */"
